name: Pet Supplies (Playful)
tagline: A bright, bouncy storefront for a fun-first pet brand.
description: A complete, working shop for a bright, playful pet brand: a real catalogue of a pop-color webbing collar and matching lead, a reversible bandana, a mega toy bundle, a cloud nap bed, a squeaky-toy pack, a roll-up travel bowl, a treat-of-the-month box and a flexible membership, with categories, collections, a bespoke pet-shop PDP and a full merchandised home page. Loud, joyful theme — a bright ground, a punchy blue primary and a pop-coral accent. Shipped as Fetch Club.
